svg.title: TabPFN v2.6 - classifier
svg.desc: Prior-Labs - per-feature transformer, two-way attention · 10.7 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input; NA: missing values in the input. How to read: each table: training rows above, test rows below, columns across; attention across rows, within a column; the arrow points from the test rows to the training rows they read; attention across columns or features, within a row; outlined cells: an embedding, where every cell becomes a vector; the prediction for the test rows; × N: the block is stacked N times; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; right columns: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count.
svg.text: Prior-Labs - per-feature transformer, two-way attention · 10.7 M parameters
Linear(6 -> 192), no bias: 3 values + 3 NaN flags
Linear(2 -> E); the target rides along as its own column
64 learned rows prepended to the context
10 slots; softmax over the classes seen
